navaids.name: Peace Monument
navaids.description: In 1948 prisoners at Hart Island erected a 30 foot tall monument. One one side is an inscribed cross and the other, the word "Peace".

Kings Point Light
navaids.description: Donated by the class of 1954, the steeple was erected in 1960. Known as King's Point Light, the U.S. Coast Guard approved its establishment as a navigational aid.
